events.title: Book Launch "The Ecosystem Mindset" by Dan Knowles: Fri 2nd Oct @14.00-16.00
events.description: Come along to the book launch and get your signed copy of The Ecosystem Mindset👇  Friday 2nd October @ 2pm - 4pm, Lancaster  How do you turn disconnected ideas, people and projects into an innovation ecosystem that actually works?  If there's one person who knows the answer to that question it's Dan Knowles.  As the founder of Northern Reach, Dan has played a pivotal role in shaping innovation across Lancashire and building the region's digital ecosystem.  You'll get to hear Dan’s take on building stronger regional economies, meet others shaping innovation across Lancashire and Cumbria, and leave with your own signed copy.  If you're a business leader or local authority decision-maker, this is one event you won't want to miss!  Register at the link.

events.title: WILD is turning 3: Mon 19th Oct @18.00-19.30
events.description: Join WILD as it celebrates is 3rd birthday and relaunch.   As part of the event, Dr Joanna Taylor will lead a thought-provoking workshop exploring bewilderment and the value of uncertainty. In a world where smartphones and AI can give us instant answers, we have fewer opportunities to sit with not knowing. Yet uncertainty is also where creativity, surprise and new ideas can thrive. Taking inspiration from historic women’s writing, Joanna will guide us through a series of simple prompts and activities designed to help us explore uncertainty in a safe, supportive and creative way.   Open to women and non-binary people working in digital, creative, marketing, tech or business around Lancaster  More information and sign up at the link.
